en.music.learning.intro: Start with five notes, build a melody, and find your rhythm. Short, hands-on lessons turn the keyboard into a place you feel at home.
en.music.learning.courseTitle: From your first note to your first melody
en.music.learning.lesson1.title: Meet middle C
en.music.learning.lesson1.desc: Find your starting point and play your first five notes.
en.music.learning.lesson1.body: Look for the group of two black keys. C is the white key immediately to their left. The C near the center of a full piano is middle C (C4). Rest your right thumb on C4, index finger on D4, and middle finger on E4. Keep your wrist relaxed and gently curved fingers close to the keys. Play C–D–E–D–C, one note at a time. Notice how moving right raises the pitch and moving left lowers it.
en.music.learning.lesson1.tip: On a real piano: thumb = 1, index = 2, middle = 3. Use 1–2–3–2–1. On screen, tap the same notes below.
en.music.learning.lesson2.title: Play a familiar melody
en.music.learning.lesson2.desc: Turn three notes into the opening of a nursery melody.
en.music.learning.lesson2.body: A melody is a sequence of pitches with a shape you can sing. Here is the opening phrase of Mary Had a Little Lamb: E–D–C–D–E–E–E. Put your right-hand fingers 1, 2, and 3 on C4, D4, and E4. Begin with finger 3, move down to 2 and 1, then climb back up. Repeated notes need a gentle release between presses. Play slowly enough that each change feels deliberate; speed can wait.
en.music.learning.lesson2.tip: Suggested fingers: 3–2–1–2–3–3–3. Hold the final E for two counts. First learn the pitches, then sing and play together.
en.music.learning.lesson3.title: Find a steady pulse
en.music.learning.lesson3.desc: Feel quarter notes and half notes at 80 beats per minute.
en.music.learning.lesson3.body: A steady pulse is the clock underneath your music. At 80 beats per minute, each beat lasts three quarters of a second. A quarter note occupies one beat; a half note occupies two. Listen to the example, then play C–C–E–E–G. Leave one beat between the first two changes and two beats between the next changes: 1, 1, 2, 2. This exercise checks when you start each note, not how long you hold a screen key.
en.music.learning.lesson3.tip: Count out loud: C (1), C (2), E (3–4), E (1–2), G (3–4). The checker allows a little timing flexibility; a restart gives you a fresh attempt.
en.music.learning.lesson4.title: Bring in your left hand
en.music.learning.lesson4.desc: Build the sound of a C major chord, one note at a time.
en.music.learning.lesson4.body: Move one octave below middle C to C3. Your left-hand little finger rests on C3, middle finger on E3, and thumb on G3. These are the three notes of a C major chord. Playing them separately makes a broken chord, a simple accompaniment pattern. Try C3–E3–G3–E3–C3. Let your hand remain soft and avoid stretching farther than feels comfortable. Later, this pattern can support a right-hand melody.
en.music.learning.lesson4.tip: Suggested left-hand fingers: 5–3–1–3–5. Learn this hand separately before combining it with a melody. Use the chord finder to explore more shapes.

zh.music.learning.intro: 从五个音符开始，串起一段旋律，找到自己的节奏。通过简短的动手练习，慢慢熟悉琴键。
zh.music.learning.courseTitle: 从第一个音符到第一段旋律
zh.music.learning.courseMeta: 4 节互动课 · 零基础 · 约 30 分钟
zh.music.learning.lesson1.title: 认识中央 C
zh.music.learning.lesson1.desc: 找到起点，弹出你的第一组五个音符。
zh.music.learning.lesson1.body: 找到两个黑键一组的位置，它们左边紧挨着的白键就是 C。完整钢琴中部附近的 C 叫中央 C（C4）。把右手拇指放在 C4，食指放在 D4，中指放在 E4。手腕保持放松，手指自然弯曲，贴近琴键。依次弹 C–D–E–D–C，感受向右音高升高、向左音高降低。
zh.music.learning.lesson1.tip: 实体钢琴指法：拇指为 1，食指为 2，中指为 3，依次使用 1–2–3–2–1。屏幕上点击同样的音即可。
zh.music.learning.lesson2.title: 弹一段熟悉的旋律
zh.music.learning.lesson2.desc: 用三个音弹出一首童谣的开头。
zh.music.learning.lesson2.body: 旋律是一连串可以哼唱的音高。这里是《玛丽有只小羊羔》的开头：E–D–C–D–E–E–E。右手 1、2、3 指放在 C4、D4、E4。从 3 指开始，依次向下到 2 和 1，再向上回来。重复音之间轻轻抬起手指，重新触键。先保证每个音准确，不必追求速度。
zh.music.learning.lesson2.tip: 建议指法：3–2–1–2–3–3–3。最后一个 E 保持两拍。先熟悉音高，再尝试边唱边弹。
zh.music.learning.lesson3.title: 找到稳定的节拍
zh.music.learning.lesson3.desc: 在每分钟 80 拍下，感受四分音符和二分音符。
zh.music.learning.lesson3.body: 稳定的拍子是音乐的时钟。每分钟 80 拍时，一拍为 0.75 秒。四分音符占一拍，二分音符占两拍。先听示范，再弹 C–C–E–E–G。相邻触键的间隔依次为 1、1、2、2 拍。本练习检测触键时间，不检测屏幕琴键的按住时长。
zh.music.learning.lesson3.tip: 大声数拍：C（1），C（2），E（3–4），E（1–2），G（3–4）。节奏判定允许一定误差，点击重新开始可开启新一轮。
zh.music.learning.lesson4.title: 让左手加入
zh.music.learning.lesson4.desc: 逐个弹出音符，认识 C 大三和弦。
zh.music.learning.lesson4.body: 从中央 C 向左移动一个八度到 C3。左手小指放在 C3，中指放在 E3，拇指放在 G3。这三个音组成 C 大三和弦。把它们分别弹出，就是分解和弦，一种简单的伴奏方式。尝试 C3–E3–G3–E3–C3。保持手部放松，不要勉强伸展。熟练后可用这个伴奏配合右手旋律。
zh.music.learning.lesson4.tip: 建议左手指法：5–3–1–3–5。先单独练习左手，再尝试双手配合。和弦查找器可以帮助你探索更多组合。
